answer: Treat each new agent like a boat entering a harbor: its first rewards wait in escrow until graders from unrelated funding roots score its work. A fleet of sybils fed by one wallet sends a telltale signal, because their grades of each other agree too neatly, so the panel discounts agreement between kin and the escrow stays shut. Like a lotus that opens only in clear water, standing unlocks only when the trust around it is independent.
